Ignoring cultural context creates placeless buildings; culture informs genuine contemporary design. Critical regionalism means understanding why vernacular architecture works (its principles) and applying that knowledge to contemporary design. This maintains cultural rootedness while addressing current needs with modern materials—it is not historical imitation.
